title: Resolve binary shared-root ancestry with S-independent mixing
statement: For K=2 code a greatest-fitness allele+ as1. At S>0 every selection branch is OR: incoming+ always replaces and incoming- never does; at S=0 no selection branches occur. Each requested root is constant or the OR of a nonempty subset of active variables. Selection replaces a variable by two with the SAME root memberships; coalescence identifies variables and unions memberships; mutation- deletes a variable; mutation+ fixes every containing root to1; empty OR is0. This exact set-valued invariant includes SHARED ancestors. While a root is unresolved, its predictable favorable-mutation resolution rate is at least alpha_+/2. Linear-birth domination gives nonexplosion; localized compensator/Gronwall plus union bound yields Pr(any root unresolved byu)<=r exp(-alpha_+u/2). Couple initial x and a stationary latent start through the SAME graph; whole-row TV<=min(1,r exp(-alpha_+u/2)), uniformly in S and boundary x. Complete unpruned extinction is unnecessary. Intermediate multi-type fitness does not obey this OR rule; no all-K extension is inferred.
